app.title: SetSetal — Cleaner communities

help.title: Help and feedback
help.using.title: Using SetSetal
help.using.body: Choose your area, filter by vehicle, and open a listing to see its service details. Confirm price and pickup arrangements directly with the provider.
help.using.demo: Listings in this prototype are demonstration examples, not confirmed real services.
help.using.real: Listings appear only after the SetSetal team has reviewed them. Agree the time and price directly with the collector.
help.report.title: Send feedback
help.report.privacy: Your feedback goes to the SetSetal team. Don't include your address or phone number: we don't ask who you are, so we can't reply.
help.report.sent.title: Feedback sent
help.report.sent.body: Thank you. The SetSetal team will review it.
help.report.queued.title: Saved on this phone, not sent yet
help.report.queued.body: We couldn't reach SetSetal just now. It's saved on this phone and will be sent automatically when you're back online. If it can't be sent within 30 days, it will be deleted.
help.report.failed.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.flushed.one: Your saved feedback has been sent.
help.report.flushed.other: {count} saved feedback messages have been sent.
help.report.emptyMessage: Please write a few words about what happened.
help.report.sentUnlinked.title: Feedback sent
help.report.sentUnlinked.body: That listing is no longer shown, so we sent your feedback without linking it.
help.report.failed.body: We couldn't reach SetSetal or save it on this phone. Your text is still in the form, so please try again later.
help.report.rejected.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.rejected.body: SetSetal couldn't accept this feedback. Check the details and try again.
help.report.unavailable.title: Feedback not sent
help.report.unavailable.body: This version of the app can't send feedback.
help.report.dropped: Some saved feedback couldn't be sent and was removed.
